csv_project_name: Consultant for City-Wide Pavement Management Study
csv_scope_of_work: Professional engineering services for the City-wide Pavement Management Study. The City intends to conduct a review of its current roadway system condition and develop a 5-year Pavement Management Plan for use in prioritizing future roadway improvements. Professional services required under this RFP include obtaining and verifying existing pavement condition data, coordinating with the Iowa Pavement Management Program (IPMP), reviewing IPMP and any other publicly available pertinent data and historical information regarding the City's roadway system.
